list.emptyBody: People you exchange an invitation with appear here, along with anyone you add yourself.

add.title: Add a contact
add.supporting: You can add someone without connecting to them. Exchange an invitation later to share with them.

import.partial: Imported {imported} of {cards} contacts. The others could not be saved.

trust.verifiedDetail: You compared this contact's code and confirmed it.
trust.unverifiedDetail: You have not compared this contact's code yet. Verifying confirms you are talking to the person you think you are.
trust.needsReverificationDetail: This contact is using a key you have not verified. That happens after they reinstall or set up a new device — verify again to be sure it is still them.
trust.notConnectedDetail: You added this person yourself, so there is no key to verify.

detail.noKeys: This contact has no Tenshu key. Exchange an invitation to connect with them.
detail.missingBody: They may have been deleted on another device.
detail.photoTooLarge: Their photo is too large to show here.
detail.photoUnknownFormat: Their photo is in a format this browser cannot show.

key.attestedNote: Attested keys cannot be changed here.

rename.title: Rename
rename.supporting: This name is yours — it is not shared with them.

delete.title: Delete contact
delete.body: This removes them and their keys from all your devices.
delete.accessWarning: This does not take away anything you have already shared with them. To stop their access to shared folders, remove them in Drive first.

unlink.title: Remove key
unlink.body: Remove the key {key} from this contact? They stay in your contacts, and you can connect again later.

relink.title: Move key
relink.body: Move the key {key} to another contact. Its verification stays with the key.

edit.title: Edit contact info
edit.preservesNote: Anything else their card holds is kept, even though it is not shown here.

verify.title: Compare your codes
verify.body: Read these six digits to {name} — over a call, or in person. They see the same six on their side. Only confirm if they match.
verify.unavailable: The code is not available right now. Unlock Tenshu and try again.
verify.unchanged: Nothing changed — this key was already at that level.

merge.keepLabel: Which one should be kept? The other is combined into it, and its name is the one you will see.
merge.noUndo: Their keys, cards and photo all move across. This cannot be undone.
merge.emptyBody: Nobody in your contacts looks like anyone else. Imported contacts are never combined for you — this is where they would show up if they were.
merge.count: {count, plural, one {1 possible duplicate} other {# possible duplicates}}

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.intro: Create a one-time invitation. Whoever accepts it becomes one of your contacts — nothing is shared until you choose to share it.
invite.qrFailed: Couldn’t draw the QR code. The link below still works.
invite.linkCaption: Have them scan this, or send them the link.
invite.oneSessionWarning: This link is shown once and works once. If you lose it, revoke the invitation and make a new one.
invite.noneAccepted: Nobody is waiting to be saved.

confirm.claimNote: That is the name they gave. Their key:
confirm.sasNote: Read these six digits to them — over a call, or in person. They see the same six on their side.
confirm.linkExisting: Or add this key to an existing contact
confirm.ownNameNote: This is what they will see you as.
confirm.failedAccept: Couldn’t complete the connection. Try again.

profile.nameSupporting: This is the name people see when you invite them.
profile.identityPending: Your identity code is not available on the web yet.

stream.stopped: Live updates stopped. What you see may be out of date.

sync.offline: You’re offline. Changes stay on this device and sync when you reconnect.
sync.needsAttention: Tenshu can’t sync right now — your storage needs attention. Changes stay on this device.
sync.locked: Tenshu is locked on this device, so nothing can sync. Unlock it to continue.
sync.deviceUnrecognized: This browser is no longer recognised as one of your devices, so it can’t sync.

runtime.connectingBody: The Tenshu tab hosting Contacts is busy. Contacts will load as soon as it answers.
runtime.elsewhereTitle: Tenshu is open in another tab
runtime.elsewhereBody: Tenshu runs in one tab at a time, so your contacts can’t get out of step. Use it here to move it to this tab.
runtime.moving: Waiting for the other tab to finish saving. This can take up to two minutes.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.body: This part of Contacts hit an unexpected error. Your contacts are safe — nothing was changed.

errors.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.error_unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.error_internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.error_not_found: That contact is no longer available.
errors.error_invalid_caller: This app is not allowed to do that.
errors.error_unannounced_session: Tenshu needs to reconnect. Please try again.
errors.error_unsupported_operation: This version does not support that yet.
errors.error_contacts_none_in_file: No contacts found in that file.
errors.error_contacts_nothing_to_export: This contact has nothing to export.
errors.error_contacts_photo_unavailable: This contact’s photo is not on this device yet. Connect to the internet and try again.
errors.error_contacts_invalid_details: That contact info could not be saved.
errors.error_contacts_unknown_key: That key is no longer known on this device.
errors.error_invite_response_changed: The reply to this invite changed after it was shown, so nothing was saved. Decline this invite and send a new one.
errors.error_invite_code_not_shown: There is no code to confirm for this invite yet. Try again in a moment.
errors.bridge: Couldn’t reach Tenshu. Make sure it is open and unlocked, then try again.
errors.bridge_timeout: Tenshu took too long to answer. Try again.
errors.bridge_not_permitted: Contacts is not allowed to do that.
